parameters.name: FromTimeService
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to immediately execute or schedule the parameter modification and restart. Valid values:

- false (default): Schedule the execution.
- true: Immediately execute.

parameters.name: PlannedEndTime
parameters.description: The latest time to start executing the target scheduled task. Specify the time in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format (UTC).

parameters.name: PlannedStartTime
parameters.description: The earliest time to start executing the scheduled task (that is, the task is executed within the target time period). Specify the time in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format (UTC).

parameters.name: ScaleApRoNumMax
parameters.description: The maximum number of steady-state AP read-only nodes. Valid values: 0 to 7.

parameters.name: ScaleApRoNumMin
parameters.description: The minimum number of steady-state AP read-only nodes. Valid values: 0 to 7.

parameters.name: ScaleMax
parameters.description: The maximum scaling limit per node. Valid values: 0 PCU to 16 PCU.

parameters.name: ScaleMin
parameters.description: The minimum scaling limit per node. Valid values: 0 PCU to 16 PCU.

parameters.name: ScaleRoNumMax
parameters.description: The maximum number of read-only nodes for scaling. Valid values: 0 to 15.

parameters.name: ScaleRoNumMin
parameters.description: The minimum number of read-only nodes for scaling. Valid values: 0 to 15.
